text:
I really don’t want to go on and on
Its endless
And people can do whatever they like

But an immigration officer has a matter of minutes to make up their mind to allow a foreigner to enter or inquire further 

My personal opinion and many folk here of “yes Family visitors should be allowed ” is perfectly valid but that’s not the job of an immigration officer.

Their job is to determine very quickly if the person presenting is genuine or not in other words coming in as a “tourist” but with the intension of either staying longer than allowed or even immigrating without permission - and there are plenty of these

So yes when someone comes to visit the holy land for what it is, or a beach holiday in Tel Aviv and present as a tourist with return ticket, hotel booking and funds with a solid centre of life in their country of origin then that is one level

If they have family here its another level of suspicion

If they have family here that are not citizens but are applying citizenship thats another level 

Then a different level of checking happens - who paid the tickets, what funds one has etc etc

Some countries are known for economic migrants more than others and so on

Anyway i was not defending policy nor telling folk to lie but just trying to point out a different perspective in order to be helpful

But the zealots and trolls are always there willing to make their comments so I will rest my case here and wish you good luck with your visiting relatives

Take care now 😁
